DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", incident_type_task_id as "incidentTypeTaskId", completed_at as "completedAt", error as "error", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_states WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_task_states (incident_report_id, incident_type_task_id, completed_at, error, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportId, :incidentTypeTaskId, :completedAt, :error, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_report_task_states SET completed_at = :completedAt, error = :error, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND incident_type_task_id = :incidentTypeTaskId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_states WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND incident_type_task_id = :incidentTypeTaskId
